comment: Single source of truth for VitaGauge / 元气指数 public sites. Do not invent medical claims. Update HTML, llms.txt and sitemap from this file.

product.storeNameZh: 元气指数：步数睡眠与健康记录

product.shortPitchEn: Make your everyday Apple Health records easier to understand. Get started without an app account or API configuration.
product.deviceFocus: iPhone, iPad and paired Apple Watch

product.ageRatingNoteZh: 本应用不面向 13 岁以下儿童。App Store 年龄分级会因设备系统版本和国家或地区而异。截至 2026 年 10 月 30 日，App Store Connect 的新版分级在大多数地区显示为 13+，部分地区为 12+；操作系统版本低于 26 时，旧全球分级为 12+，并有地区例外。请以你所在地区的 App Store 和设备实际显示为准。
product.ageRatingNoteEn: This app is not intended for children under 13. App Store age ratings vary by device operating system and country or region. As of 30 October 2026, App Store Connect shows 13+ in most regions under the updated rating system, with 12+ in some regions. On operating systems earlier than version 26, the legacy global rating is 12+, with regional exceptions. Refer to the rating actually displayed in your local App Store on your device.

disclaimerZh: 元气指数用于健康记录整理与日常自我管理，不是医疗器械，不提供诊断、处方或急救监护。统计关联不代表因果。请在作出医疗决定前咨询合格的医疗专业人士。
disclaimerEn: VitaGauge organizes health records for everyday self-management. It is not a medical device and does not provide diagnoses, prescriptions or emergency monitoring. Correlation does not establish causation. Consult a qualified health professional before making medical decisions.
citeZh: 元气指数（VitaGauge）是 Apple 健康记录助理，App Store ID 6762522305。1.2.0（5）于北京时间 2026-10-31 上架，免费提供 16 项授权健康指标的摘要、7 天趋势、本地问答和 1 个目标。主应用支持 iPhone 与 iPad，iPad 健康读取需 iPadOS 17+；配对 Apple Watch 需 watchOS 10+。Pro 一次买断，可选在线 AI 另需用户自备 Key 和单独同意。应用 HealthKit 只读、无应用账户、无广告或分析 SDK；手表显示手机同步的快照，不提供诊断或实时监护。 个人信息控制者为 Shanghai Qishan Cultural Communication Co., Ltd.，隐私联系邮箱为 weizhichao1027@gmail.com。
citeEn: VitaGauge (元气指数), App Store ID 6762522305, is an Apple Health record assistant. Version 1.2.0 (build 5) went live on 31 October 2026 in Asia/Shanghai. Free features include summaries of 16 authorized metrics, 7-day trends, local questions and one goal. It supports iPhone and iPad; Health access on iPad requires iPadOS 17+, and paired Apple Watch support requires watchOS 10+. Pro is a one-time purchase. Optional online AI needs the user’s own key and separate consent. HealthKit is read-only, with no app account, ads or analytics SDK. Watch displays a phone-synced snapshot, not diagnoses or real-time monitoring. The privacy controller is Shanghai Qishan Cultural Communication Co., Ltd.; privacy contact: weizhichao1027@gmail.com.

currentRelease.summaryZh: 1.2.0 现已在 App Store 上架。主应用支持 iPhone（iOS 15+）和原生 iPad 布局；iPad 读取 Apple 健康记录需 iPadOS 17+ 并在该设备上授权。新版改善横屏、窄窗和大字体，提供更多主屏幕小组件尺寸与锁屏行内样式。配对 Apple Watch 应用、表盘复杂功能和智能叠放组件需 watchOS 10+ 及兼容 iPhone。小组件需 iOS / iPadOS 17+。手表显示手机最近同步的五项摘要；它不是实时监测，也不会独立读取 HealthKit 或调用 AI。
currentRelease.summaryEn: Version 1.2.0 is available on the App Store. The main app supports iPhone on iOS 15+ and native iPad layouts; reading Apple Health on iPad requires iPadOS 17+ and authorization on that device. The update improves landscape, narrow windows and larger text, and adds Home Screen widget sizes and an inline Lock Screen style. The paired Apple Watch app, complications and Smart Stack widgets require watchOS 10+ and a compatible iPhone. Widgets require iOS / iPadOS 17+. The watch shows five metrics last synced from the phone; it does not independently read HealthKit, call AI or monitor health in real time.
currentRelease.supportZh: 配对手表需 watchOS 10+ 及兼容 iPhone，两端均安装元气指数 1.2.0 或更新版本。在 iPhone 上完成所需的 Apple 健康授权，打开摘要并下拉刷新，再打开手表应用点击「同步」。若没有数据，检查两端版本、设备解锁状态、配对连接及 App 安装状态。同步按钮请求手机最近已有的快照，不触发实时健康测量。手表、表盘复杂功能和智能叠放组件显示更新时间，传输和刷新时机由系统控制。iPad 不与 Apple Watch 配对，也不会从本应用的 iPhone 安装自动同步聊天、目标或 API Key。
currentRelease.supportEn: Use watchOS 10+ with a compatible paired iPhone and install VitaGauge 1.2.0 or later on both devices. Authorize the needed Apple Health types on iPhone, open Summary and pull to refresh, then open the watch app and tap Sync. If data is missing, check app versions, unlock both devices, check pairing and confirm installation. Sync requests the phone’s existing latest snapshot, not a new real-time measurement. The watch, complications and Smart Stack widgets display the update time; delivery and refresh timing are system-controlled. iPad does not pair with Apple Watch. Chats, goals and API keys do not automatically sync from the iPhone app to iPad.

watchSync.disclosureZh: 以下说明适用于 1.2.0 已提供的配对 Apple Watch 功能。你在 iPhone 上授权读取 Apple 健康，并安装配套手表 App、完成设备配对后，iPhone 会通过 WatchConnectivity 向配对的 Apple Watch 同步最近读取的五项健康摘要：步数、睡眠时长、活动能量、步行与跑步距离、体能训练次数，以及对应目标、语言、日期、时区、更新时间和用于同步排序的版本信息。该同步不经开发者服务器转发，不把个人资料、聊天内容或 API 密钥传给手表，也不会因此把数据发给第三方 AI。手表显示的是手机最近一次同步的快照，不会独立读取 HealthKit，不提供实时监测。是否向第三方 AI 分享其他相关上下文，仍由应用内单独的接收方与数据范围同意流程决定。
watchSync.disclosureEn: This section applies to the paired Apple Watch feature available in version 1.2.0. After you authorize Apple Health access on iPhone, install the companion watch app and pair the devices, iPhone uses WatchConnectivity to sync its latest five-metric summary to the paired Apple Watch: steps, sleep duration, active energy, walking and running distance, and workout count, together with related goals, language, dates, time zone, update times and revision information for ordering updates. This transfer does not pass through the developer's server. It does not send your profile, chat or API key to the watch, and does not cause data to be sent to a third-party AI provider. The watch displays the last snapshot synced from the phone; it does not independently read HealthKit or provide real-time monitoring. Sharing other relevant context with third-party AI remains subject to the separate in-app recipient and data-scope consent process.
